competitorDescription: Lovable builds full-stack web applications from a prompt. Its plans are Free, Pro, Business and Enterprise, priced by credits rather than by seats.
positioning: Atai follows the business lifecycle — IDEA → BUILD → LAUNCH → MANAGE → GROW → SCALE. Lovable is built around generating and hosting an app.
limitations: Plans, prices and entitlements on both sides change regularly. Every row below was checked on 2026-11-15 against the source linked in that row — re-verify before you decide.

rows.atai: Plan, build, launch, manage, grow and scale a business from one platform.
rows.competitor: Generate a full-stack web application from a prompt.

rows.atai: Covers the full lifecycle: business planning and offer development, building the app, launching it, then running finances, marketing and growth.
rows.competitor: Covers building and hosting a web app.

rows.atai: Explorer (free), Starter ($89.99/mo or $989.89/yr), Growth ($199.99/mo or $2,199.89/yr), Scale ($499.99/mo or $5,499.89/yr) and Enterprise (custom).
rows.competitor: Free, Pro (from $25/mo for 100 credits), Business (from $50/mo) and Enterprise, which is arranged with the sales team.

rows.atai: Subscription plans with a monthly Atai Credit allowance; yearly plans are paid upfront for 12 months and still receive credits every month.
rows.competitor: Credits rather than seats — one balance pays for building, chatting, hosting and running the app's AI features, and every plan allows unlimited workspace members.

rows.atai: Explorer: plan your business with the AI co-founder on 500 planning credits, with community support. Production launches are a paid-plan capability.
rows.competitor: Build and publish for free: 5 build credits a day (up to 30 a month), 20 Cloud credits a month and 4 credits for AI features built into user apps.

rows.atai: Full application builds from Starter upward, with up to four production apps on Growth and unlimited on Scale.
rows.competitor: The core product — describe the app and Lovable generates the frontend, backend and database wiring.

rows.atai: Starter and above: edit code in the editor or visually, download your source code and sync with GitHub. A custom domain of your own arrives with Growth.
rows.competitor: Code editing is included from Pro upward; the generated output is real code you can extend.

rows.atai: Deployment is included from Starter upward, with database management and storage; your own custom domain from Growth.
rows.competitor: Cloud hosting is included, funded by a monthly Cloud credit grant; custom domains arrive with Pro.

rows.atai: Specialist teams from Starter, expanded teams on Growth and premium teams with customization on Scale and Enterprise.
rows.competitor: Per-member monthly credit limits, bulk CSV import of those limits, and Enterprise adds sharing controls.

rows.atai: Growth adds direct support; Enterprise adds a dedicated account manager and white-glove onboarding.
rows.competitor: Email support from Pro upward; Business and Enterprise add advanced controls and governance.

rows.atai: Monthly plan credits expire at the end of the month they were issued; permanent top-up credits never expire, so heavy use moves you up a plan.
rows.competitor: Monthly plan credits expire two months after they are issued; top-up credits last twelve months; unused grants do not roll over.
